note: Metrics recovered from the execution outputs of the notebooks in paper_code/notebooks/ before those outputs were stripped for size. Each notebook stored a SINGLE hand-selected fold, not a full CV run.

mlp_baseline_stiffness.ipynb.comment: Same pipeline, different unseeded run. The gap is consistent with the run-to-run spread seen elsewhere in this repository.

rul_prototype_gcnconv.ipynb.comment: Does NOT correspond to the published RUL results. The paper reports RUL RMSE in the 100-400 cycle range and states that RUL uses the GENEA architecture; this notebook uses two GCNConv layers with edge_attr set to all zeros, i.e. no edge attributes.
